svg.title: The layers the sky is built from
svg.desc: The map is a stack of switchable layers, ordered by how well each one is proved: first what is simply a fact of the text, then guesses that are still waiting to be checked, then the verdicts of those checks, and on top the things laid over the sky by hand. Switching every layer off leaves an empty field, which is the honest starting point.
svg.text: Stacked by how well each one is proved. Any of them switches off.
a longer phrase contains a shorter one — nothing here needs proving
some come from the search engine, some from us — both still unproved
the same door · the same field · cut apart
settled by comparing what really comes up in search, not by opinion
names of groups · which run found what · who earns here
honest additions: useful to see, and not pretending to be data
Switch everything off and the field is empty.
That emptiness is the starting point, not a failure.
